result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-leg intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and traffic signals. The environment is characterized by long crossing distances and complex geometry, which increases pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic, especially in the current wet road conditions.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Complex Intersection Geometry
hazards.description: The multi-leg nature of the intersection creates multiple conflict points between turning vehicles and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised islands in the center of the wide roadway to provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians mid-crossing.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks and curb ramps, but the environment is degraded with faded crosswalk markings and poor pavement quality. The absence of dedicated pedestrian signals and the wide, open layout of the intersection suggest a design that prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The painted crosswalk is significantly worn, making it less visible to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground across the side street

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Poor pavement condition
hazards.description: Cracking and standing water on the roadway and sidewalk area can create tripping hazards or cause splashing from vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the intersection and sidewalk approach

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental-style crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness of the crossing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear information on crossing time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image shows a wide urban residential street with basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk. While traffic signals and curb ramps are present, the wide roadway and lack of mid-block refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure time.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to vehicle traffic without a refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the width of the street

hazards.name: Wet pavement glare
hazards.description: Rainy conditions and wet asphalt create glare that can reduce the visibility of lane markings and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised median or refuge island in the center of the wide roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in two stages.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked continental crosswalk and a sidewalk, but lacks dedicated pedestrian signals. Dense vegetation at the corner may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians, especially in wet conditions.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Vegetation
hazards.description: Thick foliage on the corner may hide pedestrians from approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Signal
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't walk signal is visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the left

interventions.description: Add dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove vegetation near the intersection to improve sightlines for all road users.
